item.title: Gulls Fall to Canucks
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls could not pull out a win tonight against the Abbotsford Canucks at Rogers Forum, falling 3-1. The lone San Diego goal was scored by Yegor Sidorov in the second after finding the back of the net off a rebound. The 21-year-old holds 9-10=19 points this season and has logged points in back-to-back games (1-1=2). item.title: San Diego Looks to Bounce Back Over Abbotsford
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls and Abbotsford Canucks are set for the second contest of their back-to-back series today at Rogers Forum (4 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). The meeting tonight marks the team’s sixth time competing so far this season. San Diego is 3-2-0-0 over Abbotsford so far and looks to increase that record today. The game will be San Diego’s 40th of the season. The team has posted a record of 18-13-6-2 with 44 points so far

item.title: Gulls Shutout by Canucks
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the Abbotsford Canucks at Rogers Forum today, 4-0. San Diego put up 30 shots in attempt to get on the board but could not find a way through. The team had another successful night of penalty killing, going 2-for-2 which brings their overall percentage to 85.2%. The power play still proved to be a struggle as the Gulls went 0-for-2. item.title: San Diego Eyes Fifth Straight Win Against Tucson
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls are set for their fifth meeting with the Tucson Roadrunners tonight as they return home to Pechanga Arena San Diego (7 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). Tucson is the only opponent San Diego is undefeated against so far this season. The Gulls have taken four consecutive matchups over the Roadrunners, all which came on the road. item.title: Gulls Drop to Tucson in Shootout
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the Tucson Roadrunners in a shootout tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 4-3. San Diego took a 3-0 lead early before Tucson responded with three themselves to tie the game up. After a scoreless third period and overtime, the game was sent to a shootout which went on to be the Gulls longest of the season so far with 10 shooters. item.title: Gulls Hunt for Win Over Firebirds
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls are set to take on the Coachella Valley Firebirds tonight at Acrisure Arena (7 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). The contest tonight will be the seventh time the teams have met this season and will close out the road portion of the season series. item.title: Sidorov's Heroics Give San Diego 4-3 Victory Over Coachella Valley
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls defeated the Coachella Valley Firebirds tonight for the first time since their season-opener at Acrisure Arena, 4-3. Yegor Sidorov had himself a night as he recorded his second three-point game of the season. item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls defeated their division-leading rival Ontario Reign in front of a sold-out crowd tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 4-3. item.title: ANAHEIM DUCKS REASSIGN SAM COLANGELO TO SAN DIEGO
item.description: ANAHEIM, Calif. – The Anaheim Ducks today announced the National Hockey League (NHL) club has reassigned right wing Sam Colangelo to the San Diego Gulls, Anaheim’s primary development affiliate in the American Hockey League (AHL). Colangelo, 24 (12/26/01), scored one goal in nine games with the Ducks this season. In 44 career NHL games with Anaheim, Colangelo has recorded 12-2=14 points with eight penalty minutes (PIM).
